skill.name: socialdatax-media-save-organizer
skill.description: 用户提供社媒内容链接或媒体直链和输出目录时，保存支持平台的图片、视频或音频，并整理来源链接、本地文件路径及成功失败清单。支持小红书、抖音、快手、微博、X / Twitter 和 Bilibili，使用 SocialDataX 现有命令。
skill.summary: Save media from supported social platforms and organize verified local paths, source links, and download results with SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 37 static alerts match Markdown syntax, documented service configuration, or readable multilingual text rather than the alleged threats. Contextual risks remain in automatic execution of an unpinned npm package and forwarding unvalidated payment links from API errors. No evidence found of prompt injection or credential exfiltration in the supplied files; the external CLI implementation was not provided.

remediation.issue: Commands execute the mutable socialdatax-skills@latest package with automatic npm confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and verify package provenance before execution. Explain registry downloads and obtain approval before running third-party code.

remediation.issue: Balance-error handling forwards payment links from external responses without explicit destination validation.
remediation.suggestion: Validate HTTPS destinations against documented official billing domains before presenting payment links. Reject unexpected redirects and offer independently accessed account billing.

content.user_title: Save and Organize Social Media Files
content.value_statement: Social media files are difficult to track when sources, saved paths, and failures are scattered. This skill guides SocialDataX downloads and produces a verified source-to-file inventory.
actual_capabilities: Guide media saving for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, X / Twitter, and Bilibili using SocialDataX commands.
Resolve content links through platform detail commands before selecting available image, video, or audio URLs.
Download direct media URLs without a SocialDataX API key and place different assets in separate output subdirectories.
Save repeated media URLs once while retaining their associated sources.
Report source links, verified local paths, media types, download outcomes, and failure reasons.
Check existing-file results against prior source inventories before marking assets as already saved.
limitations: Requires an external SocialDataX CLI and Node.js/npm; the supplied files do not contain the downloader implementation.
Online detail requests and Bilibili download-link retrieval require a configured SocialDataX API key and may require account credits.
Bilibili stream merging requires ffmpeg; MCP tools alone provide download links rather than saved, merged files.
Supports only documented platforms and available media URLs; unavailable content, network errors, or access restrictions can prevent saving.

use_cases.title: Archive Approved Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Save an explicit list of campaign posts and map each downloaded asset to its source and local path.

use_cases.title: Organize Research Media
use_cases.description: Collect permitted media from selected posts while preserving source links and documenting unavailable items.

use_cases.title: Resume an Editorial Collection
use_cases.description: Compare an existing source inventory with requested assets, avoid duplicate downloads, and retain verified files after partial failures.

prompt_templates.title: Save One Media File
prompt_templates.prompt: Save this direct media URL: [media URL]. Use [output directory], verify the saved file, and report its path or failure reason.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: download a single direct media link.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Images from a Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve this supported post: [post URL]. Save only its images under [output directory], with separate asset subdirectories and a source inventory.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: resolve a content page before saving selected media.

prompt_templates.title: Organize a Mixed Collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Process only these links: [link list]. Save requested media under [output directory], deduplicate identical URLs, and list verified files and failures.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize assets across supported platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and Verify a Collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [source inventory] with [link list] under [output directory]. Verify existing files, download missing assets into empty subdirectories, and update outcomes without overwriting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: reconcile an existing collection and recover missing assets.

output_examples.input: Show the inventory format for one successful X / Twitter video download.
output: Local path: verified file path returned by the command.

output_examples.input: Show a partial-failure report for two requested assets.
output: Asset 1: saved; include its original source and verified local file path.
Asset 2: failed; include its original source and the actual download error.
Retain the successful file and leave the failed item in the inventory.

best_practices: Confirm the exact link list, output directory, and permission to save the requested media before downloading.
Use empty subdirectories for different assets and verify actual files before recording successful downloads.
Review and pin the external CLI version, keep API keys private, and independently verify billing destinations before making payments.
anti_patterns: Treating a content page URL as a direct media URL or expanding the download scope beyond the approved link list.
Marking command acceptance or skipped files as successful downloads without verifying paths and source identity.
Saving API keys in inventories or following payment links from error messages without checking their destination.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow covers Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, X / Twitter, and Bilibili through documented SocialDataX commands.

faq.question: Do all downloads require an API key?
faq.answer: No. Direct media downloads need no SocialDataX key. Online detail requests and Bilibili download-link retrieval use SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY.

faq.question: What dependencies are needed?
faq.answer: CLI execution requires Node.js/npm and the external SocialDataX package. Bilibili stream merging also requires ffmpeg.

faq.question: Will existing files be overwritten?
faq.answer: The workflow uses empty asset subdirectories and checks prior inventories. Unverified existing-file matches require a different empty subdirectory.

faq.question: What happens when a download fails?
faq.answer: Successful files remain available. Failed items stay in the inventory with actual errors, without invented paths or guessed media URLs.

faq.question: Does the skill log in or publish content?
faq.answer: The supplied instructions do not request browser credentials, login, posting, likes, or comments. Downloads still write files locally and use external software.
